name: Workday extendedAmount channel mismatch (list vs net)
what_it_tests: When regional/partner/tiered pricing makes list != net, the Workday sync must not map the LIST channel (TotalLineAmount) as extendedAmount while the header uses NET; the channels must reconcile or the integration maps extendedAmount<-NetTotalPrice
proc_mechanism: Procedure regional/COLA steps write InputUnitPrice/TotalLineAmount (list) while net stays catalog; MuleSoft maps OrderItem.TotalLineAmount->extendedAmount vs header NetTotalPrice/currentContractAmount; fix = extendedAmount<-NetTotalPrice
expected_behavior: extendedAmount == header contract amount (both net); line internally consistent OR Mule maps net-only; no 'Contract Amount and Contract Line Revenue Amount must be equal' error
test_setup: Order with regional (Italy TotalLineAmount 1540 < NetTotalPrice 2400) or partner discount, Workday sync

prior_run.actual: Current Mule mapping reconciles: order 00095562 (2026-06-19) discounted line list TotalLineAmount=4130 vs NetTotalPrice=1648.35 -> payload extendedAmount=1648.35 (NET); per-line extendedAmount [3150,4356,0,1648.35,0] sum=9154.35 == currentContractAmount=9154.35 -> Workday Success. Regional 00095398 reconciled (V10 RegionalNetReconcile in V21: list==net==1540, extendedAmount=1540==contract=1540, Success). Old repro 00095381 (2026-06-08) extendedAmount=3150 (LIST) vs currentContractAmount=2835 (NET) -> Failure, but it is a stale pre-fix record (Workday_ID null, never resubmitted). ALL 4 contract-amount Failures predate ~2026-06-09; NO order created on/after 06-09 fails with this error.
prior_run.evidence: Fail repro (pre-fix, stale): https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801WC00000kML51YAG/view (00095381 payload extendedAmount=3150 LIST vs currentContractAmount=2835 NET, Failure). Fixed proof: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801WC00000lDM31YAG/view (00095562 payload extendedAmount=1648.35 NET == contract 9154.35, Success). Regional reconciled: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801WC00000kQn0zYAC/view (00095398 list==net==1540, Success).
prior_run.notes: K-04 is MuleSoft-owned (outside SF/V21). Two sub-cases: (1) regional list!=net now reconciled at the PROCEDURE layer by the V10 RegionalNetReconcile step carried into V21 (00095398 list==net==1540). (2) discount/partner list!=net is NOT reconciled in SF (V21 still produces TotalLineAmount 3150 != NetTotalPrice 2835 on 00095381 by design - list and net are distinct channels) but is reconciled in the current Mule mapping which maps extendedAmount<-NetTotalPrice (proven by 00095562/00095559 reconciled payloads + 0 post-06-09 contract-amount failures).
